{{recipe}} | [[Cookbook:Cuisine of the United States|U.S Cuisine]] | [[Cookbook:Cajun cuisine|Cajun cuisine]]

== Ingredients ==
* ½ [[Cookbook:Cup|cup]] (about 120 [[Cookbook:Milliliter|ml]]) [[Cookbook:Mayonnaise|mayonnaise]]
* [[Cookbook:Cajun Seasoning|Cajun seasoning]]
* 1 [[Cookbook:Pound|pound]] (450 [[Cookbook:Gram|g]]) [[Cookbook:Ground Beef|ground beef]]
* 4 slices [[Cookbook:Monterey Jack Cheese|pepper jack cheese]]
* 4 hamburger buns, split in half

== Procedure ==
#Combine mayonnaise and 1 Tbsp cajun seasoning. Refrigerate until needed.
#Form meat into 4 equal patties, ½ [[Cookbook:Inch|inch]] (1.25 [[Cookbook:Centimetre (cm)|cm]]) thick. Sprinkle liberally on both sides with seasoning.
#Preheat [[Cookbook:Grill|grill]]. Add burgers and cook, turning often, until desired doneness is achieved (165°F).
#Spread mayo on buns and place the burgers in. 
#Eat!
